{{unknown name}} [[File:Old woman DP056.png|thumb|250px|The old woman]] An '''old woman''' (Japanese: '''オババ''' ''hag'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP056|The Keystone Pops!]]''. This article will refer to her by her title, as she was unnamed in the episode. The old woman is a citizen of the village closest to the [[Hallowed Tower]]. When {{p|Spiritomb}} was let loose by {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Buizel}}, this woman told him and {{ashfr}} the tale of Spiritomb, and how the [[Aura]] Guardian sealed him away. The group decided they would help seal Spiritomb away just like in the legend, and the old woman followed them, occasionally giving advice. However, she displayed some anger towards the group at first when finding out that it was them who smashed the towers. She believes {{TRT}} to be "dumber than they look." ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{ghost color}}|bordercolor={{dark color light}} |ja=杉山佳寿子 ''Kazuko Sugiyama'' |en=[[Emlyn McFarland|Emily Williams]] |fi=Elise Langenoja |it=Caterina Rochira |no=Siv Klynderud |pl=Anna Sroka |es_eu=Pilar Gentil |es_la=Cecilia Airol}}
